body:
## Purpose

Follow up the maintainer's design discussion on precision loss: compare existing Pydantic contracts, explicit declaration recipes/helpers, and narrowly scoped checks on final serialized values.

Cases: Decimal to fixed-scale MariaDB storage, datetime to lower-precision legacy storage, and exact decimal representation for SQLite.

Research only: isolated public TypeAdapter probes and TDD for experimental validators; no production API/dependency changes, native backend suites, or migrations. Distinguish observed Python/Pydantic behavior from database documentation. Keep driver values going directly to Pydantic; do not introduce hidden rounding.

Deliver an evidence-backed report and runnable experiments, not a selected public API.
